source_semantics.review: Individually review all fifteen complete files and 36 hunks, including the global initializer. The added ErrorHandler throws; invalid combobox/viewport/listbox/menu/toolbar tests change console observations to thrown or rejected errors. Other fixtures restore explicit zone providers, add bottom-sheet rendering, and await dialog-opener stability. The owned legacy menu already asserts the recursive throw. The historical runner uses explicit public zone change detection, untouched public whenStable after the separately qualified bootstrap repair, and default TestBed error handling. At both advertised Core minima, RETHROW_APPLICATION_ERRORS_DEFAULT is true, compileTestModule routes application errors to TestBedApplicationErrorHandler, that handler throws when no stability waiter exists and rejects waiting promises otherwise, and ComponentFixture.whenStable registers rejection. This is source evidence, not proof that every real historical fixture/fakeAsync error phase passes. Do not add the research initializer's private framework machinery or experimentally zoneless provider. All 739 cases retain identity; 728 complete callbacks are unchanged. Pin every changed error/provider/render/await frame; no blanket thrown/logged/rejected equivalence. The actual bootstrap fix, all nine existing source qualifications and fourteen native byte bindings remain separate and unchanged. Native artifact/browser/floor execution remains required.
